body:
Hi @Contact.FirstName@,
The credit or debit card we have on file for your account is scheduled to expire in @BillingGroup.Month@ @BillingGroup.Year@.
To ensure your music service continues without interruption, please update your payment information before the expiration date.
Log in here:
https://portal.dynamicmediamusic.com
Username:
@Contact.Email@
If you’re logging in for the first time, here is your temporary Password:
@Customer.CustomerID@
Once inside:
Select Billing Group
Choose @BillingGroup.Name@
Update your payment information
Need help?
Call us anytime Monday–Friday, 9 AM–6 PM ET at 586-978-4214.
Thank you,
Billing Team at Dynamic Media
